policy.intentRule: Demote only for incomplete phonetic keys, multi-glyph initial-symbol aliases, repairs, and automatic glyph-sequence completions. Preserve source order for complete non-alias phonetic keys.
policy.reviewRule: Automated sources discover candidates; a versioned semantic review rejects ordinary, identity, critical-reporting, and materially ambiguous labels before runtime metadata is generated.

candidates.label: 婊子
candidates.rationale: Direct gendered abuse with independent corpus support and no occurrence in the standard conversation benchmark.

candidates.label: 母狗
candidates.rationale: Dehumanizing gendered abuse with independent corpus support and no occurrence in the standard conversation benchmark.

candidates.label: 廢物
candidates.rationale: Direct demeaning label; retained at normal rank after deliberate full pronunciation because it also occurs in conversation.

candidates.label: 媽的
candidates.rationale: Profanity supported by a curated lexicon and both annotated corpora; exact deliberate entry remains unchanged.

candidates.label: 他媽的

candidates.label: 神經病

candidates.label: 統一

candidates.label: 統戰

candidates.label: 祖國

candidates.label: 台獨
candidates.rationale: Delegitimizing political label; exact deliberate entry remains unchanged for legitimate discussion.

candidates.label: 同志

candidates.label: 通訊錄

candidates.label: 聖母
